stem_book: As shown in figure when a spherical cavity (centred at O) of radius 1 is cut out of a uniform sphere of radius R (centred at C), the centre of mass of remaining (shaded) part of sphere is at G, i.e. on the surface of the cavity. R can be determined by the equation : (a) (R² + R + 1)(2 − R) = 1 (b) (R² − R − 1)(2 − R) = 1 (c) (R² − R + 1)(2 − R) = 1 (d) (R² + R − 1)(2 − R) = 1
key: A (R² + R + 1)(2 − R) = 1 You marked: C
